title: Masala Curry Paste
description: A quick blended curry paste of garlic, ginger, tomato purée and warming spices, ready to use straight away or stored for later.
ingredients: 3cm (1.25 inch) piece of fresh root ginger, peeled
steps: Place all the ingredients into a mini chopper and blend until smooth.
Use immediately, or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week, or freeze in tablespoon-sized portions for up to 3 months.
notes: Use in Lemon Chicken with Masala Chickpeas (p.76) or in any curry as a quick and flavourful paste. Calories stated are per tablespoon.
